3054850.headline: Kamara (rest/back) was a full practice participant Thursday.
3054850.story: Kamara was listed as a non-participant Wednesday due to the combination of rest and back, but his return to all drills one day later gives him the all-clear ahead of Sunday's contest versus the Panthers. He may be welcoming back fellow RB Travis Etienne (hamstring) in Week 10 after the latter was designated for return from IR and so far has managed a pair of limited sessions, while Audric Estime is coming off a 16-touch showing this past Sunday versus the Browns.

4683062.headline: Worthy didn't corral any of his three targets during Thursday's 13-10 loss at Buffalo.
4683062.story: Since Josh Downs arrived via trade from Indianapolis at the deadline, Rashee Rice is leading all Chiefs wide receivers in targets with 17 over the last three contests, followed by Downs' 14, Worthy's 10, Cyrus Allen's nine, Jalen Royals' (ankle) two and Andrew Armstrong's two. Worthy's average number of targets has reduced from 5.9 per game pre-Downs to 3.3 since the addition to the position group, and the former has just a 2-38-1 line during that span. As a result, Worthy is difficult to trust as Kansas City prepares to face the Rams on the road next Thursday.

4683062.headline: Worthy caught two of four targets for 38 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
4683062.story: Worthy was able to eclipse 30 receiving yards for just the second time in the last five weeks, but it was a step in the right direction after being blanked on three targets in Week 10. The wide receiver's biggest moment of the game came in the fourth quarter when he connected with quarterback Patrick Mahomes for an 18-yard touchdown. The score was Worthy's second of the year and first since Week 2, and his next chance to build off of Sunday's performance will come on Thanksgiving against the Bills.

4683062.headline: Worthy failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
4683062.story: Worthy ran a team-high 37 routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks, but on a day Mahomes targeted nine different players, Worthy was the only one to not record a catch. With Josh Downs now in the fold and working to get comfortable in the offense, Worthy's role will likely only continue to shrink. On just eight routes in his team debut Sunday, Downs posted a 4-53-1 receiving line on five targets. Worthy hasn't produced that many fantasy points in a game all season. He's waiver-wire fodder in 12-team redraft leagues.

4683062.headline: Worthy (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice for Kansas City.
4683062.story: Worthy was considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets in the fourth quarter. A quick return to full practice participation suggests Worthy will be fine for the upcoming matchup with Atlanta on Sunday, but his target share may decline in the second half of the season after Kansas City traded for WR Josh Downs.

4697815.headline: White turned two kickoff returns into 48 yards during Monday's 22-20 win over the Bengals.
4697815.story: With Jacory Croskey-Merritt back from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, White saw a season-low 15 snaps on offense, and the latter's lone carry early in the fourth quarter was nullified by a defensive offside penalty. Croskey-Merritt and Austin Ekeler were responsible for 20 of the Commanders' 26 rushing attempts Monday, and it looks like the return of the former has squeezed White out of the offensive gameplan. The Commanders will hit the road for each of their next two games, starting with Sunday against the Cardinals.

4697815.headline: White (heel) is active for Monday's game against the Bengals.
4697815.story: White showed up on the Commanders' Week 11 injury report Friday as limited due to a heel issue and then didn't practice Saturday, leaving him questionable to play Monday. While he's confirmed to be available, he also will be welcoming back Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) from IR for the first time since Week 5, which may eat into White's workload.

4697815.headline: White (heel) is listed as questionable for Monday's game versus the Bengals.
4697815.story: White was added to the Commanders' Week 11 injury report Friday as limited due to a heel issue, and he followed it up with a DNP one day later before getting tagged ahead of Monday's matchup. At the same time, current IR member Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) completed a full week of drills and also is listed as questionable. If he's activated by Monday afternoon, he'll vie with Austin Ekeler and White for touches, assuming the latter avoids inactive status about 90 minutes before an 8:15 p.m. ET kickoff.

4697815.headline: White (heel) is trending toward being available for Monday's game against the Bengals, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.
4697815.story: White has been working through a heel injury, but head coach Dan Quinn told reporters Saturday that the fifth-year running back should be available to play. White has operated as the Commanders' RB1 over the team's last four games, but his role will likely shrink for Week 11 given that Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is expected to be activated off injured reserve ahead of Monday night's game.

4241985.headline: The Broncos placed Dobbins on the reserve/suspended list Wednesday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
4241985.story: Head coach Sean Payton had previously announced Tuesday that Dobbins would be suspended for Friday's game against the Steelers due to conduct detrimental to the team, but it wasn't immediately clear whether or not the running back would count toward the 53-man roster. As a result of Wednesday's transaction, the Broncos will now have an open roster spot to use for Week 12, and Tyler Badie (thumb) could be activated from injured reserve to help fill the void in the backfield. Dobbins' suspension came after he played just one snap in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders on Sunday, when rookie

4241985.headline: Broncos head coach Sean Payton announced Tuesday that Dobbins has been suspended one game for conduct detrimental to the team, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.
4241985.story: Payton didn't go into details regarding what contributed to the Broncos' decision to suspend Dobbins, but the ban comes after the veteran running back played a season-low one snap in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders. Dobbins wasn't present for Wednesday's practice, and Payton confirmed that the 27-year-old will remain away from the team throughout Week 12 prep, per Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com. With Dobbins out of the picture for Friday's matchup with the Steelers, rookie Jonah Coleman should be in store for another hefty workload out of the backfield after breaking out for 129 yards from scr

4241985.headline: Dobbins logged just one snap in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders, though head coach Sean Payton said Monday that Dobbins "is going to be super important" moving forward, Will Petersen of 104.3 The Fan reports.
4241985.story: Dobbins' opportunities have been dwindling since Week 7 against Arizona, when he dropped to 14 offensive snaps after tallying 31 the week prior. That contest against the Cardinals was when rookie Jonah Coleman returned from a four-game absence, and Coleman has since forced his way into Denver's lead-RB role with blossoming production that has included five rushing TDs over his past three games. Coleman got nearly every running-back snap for Denver on Sunday, with practice-squad elevation Cody Schrader logging just two snaps and Dobbins one. Despite Payton's proclamation that Dobbins still has

4241985.headline: Dobbins rushed once for no gain during Sunday's 38-24 win over Las Vegas.
4241985.story: Dobbins finished with fewer than 10 carries for the fourth straight game, and his lone rush came in the first quarter of the team's Week 11 victory. Rookie Jonah Coleman (24-111-3) has officially taken full command of Denver's backfield, and Dobbins figures to have to compete with RJ Harvey (knee) for the No. 2 spot behind Coleman with Harvey returning from injured reserve as soon as Week 12 against the Steelers.

2473037.headline: Myers missed his sole field-goal attempt and made three PATs in the Seahawks' 21-13 win over the Raiders on Sunday.
2473037.story: Myers missed a 44-yard field-goal attempt with 7:05 remaining in the game that would have put the Seahawks up 14 points. The kicker is now 16-for-19 on field-goal attempts and 21-for-23 on PATs over 10 regular-season contests in 2026.

2473037.headline: Myers made his only field-goal attempt and converted both of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 17-3 win versus the Cardinals.
2473037.story: The Seahawks' offense put forth a relatively modest showing in Week 9 with backup quarterback Drew Lock (oblique) at the helm, but Myers made good on the few opportunities that he did have, rebounding somewhat from a rough game in Week 8 where he missed two kicks. Starting quarterback Sam Darnold (quadriceps) will again be out in Week 10 at Las Vegas, but Myers will at least have the benefit of kicking indoors come Sunday.

2473037.headline: Myers missed his lone field-goal attempt and made one of two PATs in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Bears.
2473037.story: Myers converted a chip-shot 27-yard field goal in the second quarter but later missed an extra point wide to the left before halftime. He then had a 33-yard field-goal try blocked in the fourth quarter. On the season, the veteran kicker is 14-for-16 on FGAs and 17-for-19 on PATs. He'll be a kicker to stream next Sunday at home against the Cardinals.

2473037.headline: Myers went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday night's 20-3 win over the Chiefs.
2473037.story: Myers was able to make multiple field goals for the third straight game, converting a 25-yarder in the second quarter before later adding a 35-yard make in the second half. The kicker has now gone 14-for-15 on field-goal tries, including 3-for-3 from 50-plus yards, over the first seven games of the 2026 campaign.

4373626.headline: Allgeier carried the ball seven times for 23 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City.
4373626.story: Game script fairly quickly put the Cardinals' running game in mothballs, and Allgeier wound up splitting the backfield workload nearly equally with Bam Knight, who picked up 45 scrimmage yards on eight touches. Allgeier has gone three straight games without reaching 50 rushing yards or getting into the end zone, but those games were also against very tough opponents (the Seahawks in Week 9 and the Rams in Week 10). The fifth-year RB could find a little more running room in Week 12 against the Commanders, but Jeremiyah Love (ankle) might also be ready to rejoin the lineup by then.

4373626.headline: Allgeier mustered five carries for 14 yards and didn't gather in his only target during Sunday's 34-6 defeat to the Rams.
4373626.story: With Bam Knight back in the lineup in Week 10 after one absence due to a concussion, Allgeier didn't reach double-digit touches for the first time since Week 5, a span in which the latter's 65 touches went for 334 yards from scrimmage and two total TDs. Knight himself found a similar lack of success Sunday with just 19 yards on his five rushes. Because the Cardinals racked up just 123 yards of offense in rookie QB Carson Beck's first NFL start, it's tough to envision worse outcomes moving forward, though the team does take on the surging Chiefs next Sunday on the road.

4373626.headline: Allgeier compiled 17 carries for 46 yards and caught two of three targets for no yards during Sunday's 17-3 defeat at Seattle.
4373626.story: Allegeier has reeled off 10-plus touches in four straight contests, a span in which he's turned 65 touches into 334 yards from scrimmage and two total TDs. He's been the beneficiary of repeated ankle injuries to rookie first-round pick Jeremiyah Love, who must remain on IR for at least three more outings after Sunday's matchup, and the other current top RB on the active roster (Bam Knight) is in the concussion protocol, which will require clearance from an independent neurologist for his next game action. As a result, Allgeier is set up to retain a significant workload until Knight gets the al

4373626.headline: Allgeier is slated to work as Arizona's No. 1 running back beginning with Sunday's game at Seattle after Jeremiyah Love (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.
4373626.story: After previously leading the Cardinals backfield when Love was sidelined due to a different ankle injury Weeks 6 and 7, Allgeier is now slated for a longer run atop the depth chart while Love is projected to miss 4-to-5 weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain. Love sustained his latest ankle injury late in the first quarter of Sunday's overtime win over the Cowboys, with his early exit clearing the way for Allgeier to run wild. Allgeier finished with a career-high 147 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries along with 44 yards and another score on five receptions. In addition to Love getting hurt,

3055899.headline: Butker made one of two field-goal attempts and his lone PAT in Thursday night's 13-10 loss to the Bills.
3055899.story: After making a 26-yard field goal earlier in the game, Butker missed wide right from 46 yards in the fourth quarter, leaving the score tied 10-10 following an 11-play drive. It was Butker's eighth missed field goal of the season, and he's also missed an extra point. Butker has converted a career-low 65.2 percent of his field-goal tries in 2026. The Chiefs may need to make a move at the position ahead of next Thursday's date with the Rams.

3055899.headline: Butker made both of his field-goal attempts while going 4-for-4 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
3055899.story: Butker was able to make multiple field goals in a contest for the first time since Week 6, and most importantly, he didn't miss a kick. The kicker made both field goals in the second quarter, converting attempts from 40 and 44 yards. Butker has now gone 14-for-21 on field-goal tries, including 2-for-8 from 50-plus yards, while converting 31 of 32 PATs over 10 contests so far during the 2026 season.

3055899.headline: Butker made all five PATs in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
3055899.story: Butker did not attempt a field goal in the contest, as the Chiefs solely scored touchdowns. He now moves to 27-for-28 on PATs in 2026 as he continues to struggle to hold onto the starting kicker job.

3055899.headline: Butker will remain Kansas City's kicker ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.
3055899.story: On that topic, coach Andy Reid said Wednesday, "I'm gonna stick with Butker this week." While the veteran kicker has held on to the top job through the Chiefs' first eight games, he's had accuracy issues this season, having converted 12 of his 19 field-goal attempts and making 22 of his 23 extra-point tries in that span. Reid's comment about Butker on Wednesday implies that the team's kicking situation is being evaluated on a weekly basis. Justin Tucker is on Kansas City's practice squad, and he remains an option should Reid decide that a switch is in order down the road.

4427095.headline: Douglas is set to maintain a prominent role Sunday against the Chargers, as A.J. Brown (hamstring) and Romeo Doubs (shoulder, IR) won't play.
4427095.story: Douglas had 178 yards and a touchdown in a career-best two-game stretch spanning Weeks 8 and 9, but he was limited to one catch for four yards in his most recent appearance, which QB Drake Maye (lower leg) left early. With Tommy DeVito under center in Week 12, Douglas will try to get back on track in New England's banged-up passing game coming out of a bye week.

4427095.headline: Douglas caught one of three passes for four yards during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
4427095.story: The Patriots' offense was effective on the first drive of the game, but that was where the good news ended for New England after Drake Maye was knocked out for the rest of the contest due to an ankle injury. Tommy DeVito took over under center, and the offense struggled to move down the field for the rest of the game. For Douglas, it was the third time this season that he was held to one catch, with the last instance taking place in Week 3 against the Jaguars. A.J. Brown -- who was cleared to return from a two-game absence due to knee and ankle injuries -- also picked up a hamstring injury dur

4427095.headline: Douglas brought in five of nine targets for 102 yards in the Patriots' 45-27 loss to the Packers on Sunday.
4427095.story: Douglas tied for the team lead in receptions and set the pace in both receiving yards and targets while serving as Drake Maye's top target in the absence of A.J. Brown (knee) and Romeo Doubs (IR, shoulder). Douglas also recorded a team-high 36-yard grab among his five catches, and both the yardage and target tallies were season highs. Douglas has at least 76 receiving yards in three of the past four games heading into a Week 10 matchup against the Lions in Germany next Sunday.

4427095.headline: Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
4427095.story: Most of his production came on a nifty 48-yard catch-and-run in the fourth quarter, as Douglas took a strike from Drake Maye along the sideline but then curled back toward the middle of the field and dashed the remaining 30 yards to the end zone while out-racing four Miami defenders. It was the fourth touchdown of the season for the fourth-year wideout, a new career high, and Douglas will take a 26-332-4 line on 37 targets through eight games into a Week 9 tilt against the Packers.

4428718.headline: Tucker caught two of 10 targets for 50 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
4428718.story: Tucker finished with a team-high 10 targets, but he was unable to get on the same page with quarterback Fernando Mendoza for the majority of the game. Most of the wide receiver's production came on a 39-yard catch in the fourth quarter, and he has now combined to reel in three of 12 targets for 59 yards over Mendoza's first two career starts.

4428718.headline: Tucker caught one pass for nine yards on two targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.
4428718.story: In Fernando Mendoza's first career start at quarterback, Tucker saw just 6.9 percent of the targets, while Jack Bech led the team with seven looks. Tucker looks like someone who won't be usable in fantasy until he shows some tangible chemistry with the young quarterback.

4428718.headline: Tucker caught four of eight targets for 55 yards during Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.
4428718.story: Tucker finished tied for the team lead in targets with tight end Brock Bowers, garnering at least five targets for the fifth time in the team's last six contests. The wide receiver rebounded well after being blanked in Week 8 versus the Jets, securing four or more receptions for the seventh time this season. Tucker has now reeled in 33 of 56 targets for 529 yards and four touchdowns over the Raiders' first nine games during the 2026 campaign.

4428718.headline: Tucker did not catch his only target Sunday in the Raiders' 38-33 Week 8 win over the Jets.
4428718.story: Despite quarterback Kirk Cousins throwing for 247 yards, Tucker had only one ball thrown his way. In fact, only one Raiders wideout -- Jalen Nailor -- had a reception, as Cousins targeted tight ends on 16 of his 26 passes. Tucker had caught either four or five passes in each of his prior six games and collected at least 97 receiving yards in three of those contests, though he finished below 45 yards in the other three. It's notable that he logged a season-low 52 percent offensive snap share against the Jets, but he should be in for better days ahead, beginning with a Week 9 matchup in San Fran

4241464.headline: Head coach Kyle Shanahan announced that Jones will start in place of Brock Purdy (ankle) on Sunday against the Seahawks.
4241464.story: Purdy didn't practice this week and was ruled out for Week 12 on Friday, setting Jones up for his first start of the campaign. In eight starts for an injured Purdy in 2025, Jones went 5-3, completed 201 of 289 passes (69.6 percent) for 2,151 yards, 13 touchdowns and six interceptions, rushed 28 times for 64 yards and fumbled four times (two lost).

4241464.headline: Jones (illness) is active for Sunday night's matchup against Minnesota, Brooke Evans of the 49ers' official website reports.
4241464.story: Jones is good to go for Sunday Night Football after dealing with an illness at practice throughout the week. The quarterback will operate in his primary reserve role behind starter Brock Purdy versus the Vikings in Mexico City.

4241464.headline: Jones (illness) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.
4241464.story: Jones put together an LP-DNP-LP practice log while working through an illness, which puts him in jeopardy of not being available for Sunday's contest. If Jones is inactive, then Kurtis Rourke would operate as the 49ers' backup to Brock Purdy,

4241464.headline: Jones (illness) did not participate at practice Thursday.
4241464.story: Jones popped up on the 49ers' injury report with an unspecified illness Wednesday, and now his status for Week 11 is up in the air. If he can't practice in full Friday, there's a decent chance he'll end up carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

3116407.headline: Rudolph completed nine of 15 passes for 142 yards and a touchdown in Friday's 27-5 win over the Broncos.
3116407.story: Making his first start of the season after Aaron Rodgers' abrupt departure from the Steelers, Rudolph avoided committing any turnovers and connected with DK Metcalf on a 22-yard TD in the first quarter. The QB didn't do much else aside from getting sacked for a safety, however, as the defense did most of the scoring for Pittsburgh. Rudolph's 15 pass attempts were less than half of the 31 carries that Jaylen Warren and Rico Dowdle handled between them, and that could be a strong hint as to how the offense will operate the rest of the way. Rudolph is expected to remain under center in Week 13 ag

3116407.headline: Fantasy buzz: Joe Milton, Jahmyr Gibbs served up a fantasy feast on Thanksgiving
3116407.story:
My friends in Philadelphia are already calling it the "Joe Milton Game" after the Philadelphia Eagles rallied to defeat the Dallas Cowboys.

Just when you thought the

3116407.headline: Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos and could remain atop the depth chart for the rest of the season with the Steelers waiving Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday.
3116407.story: Late Tuesday, the Steelers opted to make a change under center, naming Rudolph the Week 12 starter and sending Rodgers to the bench on the heels of poor performances by the offense in back-to-back losses to the Bengals and Eagles coming out of a bye week. The Steelers initially planned to make Rodgers inactive for Week 12 but keep him on the roster, but the team now intends to part ways with the four-time MVP after he harshly criticized head coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" on Wednesday. The impending departure of Rodgers should thus give Rudolph an extended le

3116407.headline: Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.
3116407.story: In a stunning move late Tuesday night, the Steelers benched Aaron Rodgers following two straight losses to the Bengals and Eagles, where the offense didn't play well at all, as Rodgers averaged a paltry 5.1 yards per attempt. The Steelers will see if Rudolph can provide a spark for 6-4 Pittsburgh. Rudolph has made 19 career regular-season starts and has averaged 6.6 yards per attempt with a 30:22 TD:INT on 742 pass attempts.

4240391.headline: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that DeVito is the team's starting quarterback, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports. "We're excited about that. He had a good preseason, and Tommy's improved," Vrabel said of DeVito.
4240391.story: With Drake Maye (fibula) hurt early in Week 10 against Detroit, DeVito stepped in at quarterback but managed to complete just 12 of 24 pass attempts for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception. He added 19 yards on four carries. The 28-year-old does have some starting experience -- he helmed the Giants offense for eight starts between 2023 and 2024 -- but he didn't play at all in 2025. For now, the Patriots are at least communicating that they'll stand pat and not look for help at quarterback outside the organization. However, the team is barely hanging on in the AFC playoff race with a 5-5

4240391.headline: Head coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that DeVito will start in Week 12 against the Chargers on Nov. 29, Mike Reiss and Adam Schefter of ESPN.com report.
4240391.story: Drake Maye was diagnosed with a fractured right fibula, which he sustained in the first quarter of the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Week 10 in Munich. DeVito filled in for the rest of that contest and completed 12 of 24 passes for 81 yards, one touchdown and one interception while turning four carries into 19 yards. DeVito looks like he'll be New England's starter coming out of the bye, with rookie seventh-round pick Behren Morton operating as the backup.

4240391.headline: Mike Reiss of ESPN.com notes via ESPN's Adam Schefter that there are fears  DeVito's teammate, Drake Maye, may have sustained a fractured ankle during Week 10 action.
4240391.story: Regarding Maye's status going forward, head coach Mike Vrabel indicated that he'll wait for further information before estimating how long his starting QB might be out, but he also acknowledged he "wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the (Week 11) bye," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports. As a result, DeVito is in a position to start Sunday, Nov. 29 against the Chargers and possibly beyond. That said, as NFL reporter Jordan Schultz suggests, New England is expected to explore the QB market in the coming days, be it through a practice squad addition or a veteran free agent s

4240391.headline: DeVito completed 12 of 24 passes for 81 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich. He added 19 yards on four carries.
4240391.story: Drake Maye (ankle) was forced to leave the game early after an Aidan Hutchinson (knee) sack, putting DeVito under center for the third time this season, but the first time with the outcome still in doubt. The 28-year-old QB had little luck moving the ball, and his 10-yard TD toss to Lan Larison in the fourth quarter came when the score was already 28-3. The severity of Maye's ankle injury isn't yet known, but the Patriots fortunately get a bye in Week 11 to give him extra recovery time. If he's still unavailable after that, DeVito could find himself starting in Week 12 against the Chargers.

4433971.headline: McCord completed 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He also rushed twice for nine yards.
4433971.story: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

4433971.headline: McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble that was returned for a touchdown.
4433971.story: Drawing his first career start as a result of Malik Willis having gone on injured reserve with an abdomen injury earlier in the week, McCord acquitted himself well overall in a favorable matchup. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles spread the ball around to nine different targets, and he had a statement three-yard touchdown run on the first play of the fourth quarter when he powered through a pair of defenders and broke the plane despite having his facemask pulled. McCord's one turnover was very costly, however, as it was recovered on the Dolphins' six-yard line and returned for a short to

4433971.headline: McCord will step in as the Dolphins' starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Indianapolis after Miami placed Malik Willis (core) on injured reserve Tuesday, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.
4433971.story: A 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles, McCord will be making his NFL debut Sunday, after he had been active for each of the 1-7 Dolphins' first eight games but didn't see any playing time behind Willis. Before landing with the Dolphins in a trade prior to Week 1, the 24-year-old signal-caller looked sharp during preseason action as a member of the Packers, completing 46 of 70 passes for 446 yards and a 4:0 TD:INT while adding 16 yards on five carries over three games. Expectations should still be held in check for McCord in his first regular-season action, especially while he'll be working wit

4433971.headline: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley confirmed Tuesday that McCord will begin the season as the team's No. 2 quarterback, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.
4433971.story: Miami bolstered its quarterback room by claiming Brady Cook off waivers Monday, but he'll occupy the third spot on the depth chart while McCord serves as the top backup to Malik Willis. Acquired from the Packers over the weekend in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round pick, McCord is coming off an impressive preseason in which he completed 46 of 70 pass attempts (65.7 percent) for 446 yards and a 4:0 TD:INT over three games. The 23-year-old is still waiting to make his NFL debut, as he spent all of last season on the Eagles' practice squad after failing to make the roster as a rookie sixth-round pi

4429020.headline: Uiagalelei will be the Chargers' starting quarterback against the Patriots on Sunday due to the absence of Justin Herbert (concussion), Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
4429020.story: Uiagalelei got his first taste of NFL regular-season action in Week 11 against the Jets after Herbert suffered a concussion, with the former completing two of seven passes for 27 yards and a touchdown. With Herbert in the league's protocol for head injuries, Uiagalelei will make his first career start Sunday against a New England defense that ranks 27th in the NFL in passing yards allowed per game (239.0). Jake Browning also is available to serve as Los Angeles' backup.

4429020.headline: Uiagalelei completed two of seven passes for 27 yards and a touchdown after replacing Justin Herbert (finger) in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans, and head coach Jim Harbaugh said after the game that Herbert could have a fractured finger, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.
4429020.story: Uiagalelei was inaccurate in his first taste of regular-season NFL action but threw a 15-yard touchdown pass to Derius Davis. If Herbert isn't available to face the Ravens on MNF in Week 10 and Trey Lance (groin) isn't ready to return from injured reserve, Uiagalelei would presumably be tabbed for the first regular-season start of the latter's career.

4429020.headline: Uiagalelei (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game versus Seattle, though he is listed as the team's emergency quarterback.
4429020.story: Trey Lance (groin) is available to suit up in Week 4, meaning Uiagalelei will be a healthy scratch. However, if Lance and Justin Herbert exit the contest due to injury, illness or ejection, Uiagalelei will serve as the team's emergency signal-caller.

4429020.headline: Uiagalelei (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Sunday, Eric Smith of the Chargers' official site reports.
4429020.story: The Chargers signed Uiagalelei to the active roster Saturday to provide depth at quarterback due to the uncertainty around the status of Trey Lance (groin). Lance has been cleared to play Week 3 and will be Justin Herbert's backup. As the emergency QB3, Uiagalelei is prohibited from playing Sunday unless both Herbert and Lance were to leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

11394.headline: Coach Mike LaFleur has ruled out Carson Beck (back) for Sunday's game against the Commanders, which sets the stage for Johnson to start the contest, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
11394.story: Johnson, who completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 loss to Kansas City in Week 11, thus is set to make his second straight start for the Cardinals. With no teams on bye this week, Johnson's Week 12 fantasy utility is limited to Superflex formats and to fantasy managers scrambling for a short-term injury replacement at the QB position.

11394.headline: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that Johnson is preparing to start Sunday's game versus the Commanders due to Carson Beck's back injury, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.
11394.story: Beck won't practice Wednesday due to continued issues with back spasms, which held him out of this past Sunday's loss in Kansas City. In place of Beck, Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and one touchdown while also taking two carries for five yards. Friday's injury report will reveal if Beck has a chance to play in Week 12, and by proxy if Johnson will get another spot start.

11394.headline: Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. he added five yards on two carries.
11394.story: The 40-year-old QB was pressed into duty with rookie Carson Beck (back) on the shelf, and Johnson unsurprisingly wasn't really up to the task after the Cardinals fell into a 14-0 hole before the first quarter was over. Johnson spent most of his afternoon finding Trey McBride for short gains, and he did hit Simi Fehoko for a two-yard score in the second quarter. Beck doesn't figure to miss much time, but if Johnson gets another start in Week 12, he'll be taking on a much less formidable Commanders defense.

11394.headline: Johnson will start Sunday's game against the Chiefs with Carson Beck (back) having been downgraded to out for Week 11, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
11394.story: Coming out of his first NFL start in a Week 10 loss to the Rams, Beck was added to the injury report Thursday due to back spasms. He was listed questionable after failing to practice Friday before the Cardinals offically ruled him out for Week 11 a day later. With Beck set to sit out, the 40-year-old Johnson will pick up his 12th career NFL start while seeing action for his eighth different team since entering the league in 2008 as a fifth-round pick of the Buccaneers. He most recently started in the final two games of the 2025 season as a member of the Commanders, completed 64.4 percent of hi

2578570.story:
The first thing fantasy managers should know about Week 12 is that the Green Bay Packers and Los Angeles Rams get the week started this Wednesday night.

2578570.headline: Brissett completed 24 of 37 passes for 276 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He added seven rushing yards on two carries.
2578570.story: It was another decent showing for the veteran quarterback, and his first TD pass in two games as a Raven came on a trick that involved a direct snap to Derrick Henry, who flipped it Brissett for a 52-yard strike to Rashod Bateman. Brissett has also kept Zay Flowers relevant, feeding the wideout 18 targets for a 14-171-0 line. Baltimore's passing attack will try to keep improving in Week 12 against the Texans.

2578570.headline: Brissett completed 33 of 49 passes for 340 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for two yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
2578570.story: Brissett looked like a natural fit in coordinator Declan Doyle's offense despite having only practiced a handful of days with the Ravens following his trade from the Cardinals, amassing his highest passing yardage total since Week 11 of last season. As he'd often done with Trey McBride in Arizona, Brissett focused heavily on the tight-end position in his Baltimore debut, connecting with Mark Andrews and Josh Cuevas a combined 11 times for 119 yards. Brissett recorded completions to seven different targets overall, but his one interception did lead to a Chargers touchdown. Brissett's prospects

Each Monday, before the current NFL week ends, we will identify players worthy of your attention who are available in at least 50% of ESPN standard leagues. 4360423.headline: Penix completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
4360423.story: Penix struggled while the game was still in question, but he did manage to pad his stats some down the stretch as the Falcons unsuccessfully tried to overcome their deficit. Penix connected with eight different targets overall on the afternoon, and he ultimately finished with a season high in passing yards. Penix has now tossed six interceptions in the last three games, however, and he'll look to regroup during the Week 11 bye before tackling a difficult matchup against the Vikings on the road on Sunday, Nov. 29.

4360423.headline: Penix completed 20 of 31 passes for 162 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 34-17 loss to Cincinnati. He added 50 rushing yards on three carries.
4360423.story: It looked like it would be a big day for the Falcons offense when Penix led his team to points on its first two drives. including a one-yard TD to Charlie Woerner, but Atlanta managed just seven more points over the final three quarters. The touchdown pass was Penix's 10th of the season, setting a new career high, but he's also been picked off five times in the last two games after throwing only one INT in his first five contests of 2026. He'll face a tough test in Week 10 against Kansas City.

4360423.headline: Penix completed eight of 24 passes for 125 yards with no touchdowns and four interceptions while rushing five times for 11 yards in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
4360423.story: Penix endured a career-worst all-around game in rainy conditions after coming into the afternoon with just one interception in his first five games. Only two of Penix's four picks led to Buccaneers points -- and just a pair of field goals at that -- but the Falcons defense was helpless against Tampa Bay's ground attack in the shutout. Sunday's conditions were a clear outlier, so Penix should be expected to bounce back across the pond in a Week 9 matchup against a vulnerable Bengals secondary next Sunday in Madrid.

4432773.headline: Thomas could handle a larger role Sunday against the Titans, as Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times-Union reports that Parker Washington (shoulder) won't suit up.
4432773.story: Thomas has had a disappointing third season in Jacksonville, mustering a meager 84 receiving yards over his last eight appearances while seemingly having fallen out of favor in coach Liam Coen's offense. Washington's absence against Tennessee's struggling secondary could provide Thomas with an opportunity to turn back the clock and put up a performance reminiscent of the 2024 first-round pick's elite rookie season. Jakobi Meyers and Josh Cameron also are in line for expanded roles in Jacksonville's wide-receiver room.

4432773.headline: Thomas caught one pass for an 18-yard touchdown on three targets in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
4432773.story: Thomas' three targets were a distant fourth on the team, as Parker Washington (17), Jakobi Meyers (10) and Josh Cameron (seven) combined to see a combined 34 looks on Trevor Lawrence's 47 pass attempts. Thomas ran 32 routes, 14 more than Cameron as the Jaguars' nominal WR3, but the former hasn't been seeing meaningful target volume for months. After drawing nine targets in Week 2, Thomas has averaged 2.1 targets per game over his last eight contests. He's well off the fantasy radar while Washington and Meyers are healthy.

4432773.headline: Thomas caught three of four targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
4432773.story: The three catches tied his season high, while the four targets represented his biggest volume since Week 2. The Jaguars' decision not to deal Thomas at the trade deadline remains a curious one, as the third-year wideout simply doesn't have a significant role in Liam Coen's offense and might not step into one even if someone like Parker Washington got injured -- Josh Cameron was more productive Sunday on three targets and caught one of Trevor Lawrence's three TDs. Thomas will take a 13-146-2 line on 26 targets over nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Giants.

4432773.headline: The Jaguars have relayed to inquiring teams that they intend to keep Thomas through Tuesday's trade deadline, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
4432773.story: After sending out a first-round pick, two second-round picks, a fifth-round pick and a sixth-round pick Monday in separate deals to bring in defenders Jordan Davis, Jessie Bates and Davon Godchaux, the Jaguars likely could have recouped some of that draft capital if they had opted to move Thomas. Instead, Fowler indicates that the Jaguars plan to keep the rest of their roster intact ahead of the deadline, which will result in Thomas sticking around. 5081397.headline: Sampson rushed four times for six yards and caught four of six targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
5081397.story: Sampson hardly carries the ball for Cleveland and is merely the pass-catching complement to Quinshon Judkins out of the backfield. Across five games this season, Sampson has rushed 19 times for 79  yards while adding 16 catches for 152 yards on 22 targets. He's playable in PPR fantasy leagues as a desperation RB2 option, particularly in games for which the Browns are projected to play from behind.

5081397.headline: Fantasy football last-minute pickups: 12 players who can help in deeper leagues
Sampson rushed eight times for 21 yards while catching three of six targets for 27 yards during Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss against the Saints.
5081397.story: Sampson toted the rock a season-high eight times, but he averaged a minimal 2.6 yards per carry. The running back remained heavily involved in the passing game, tying wide receiver KC Concepcion for second on the team in targets behind wideout Denzel Boston (seven). Sampson has now reeled in three or more passes in three straight games, and he figures to remain most valuable as a pass catcher for fantasy managers ahead of the team's Week 10 matchup with Houston.

4258620.headline: Szmyt made two of his three field-goal attempts and all three of his PATs in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
4258620.story: Szmyt knocked through field goals from 49 and 26 yards in Sunday's contest. The kicker stumbled in the fourth quarter, missing a 54-yard attempt with 11:02 remaining that would've brought the game within a point. Szmyt is now 21-for-24 on field-goal attempts and 15-for-16 on PATs over 10 regular-season contests in 2026.

4258620.headline: Szmyt went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT during Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to New Orleans.
4258620.story: Szmyt was able to convert multiple field-goal tries for the eighth straight game, and his three makes matched a season high for the 28-year-old. The kicker made a 41-yarder in the second quarter and a 30-yard attempt in the third quarter before tying the game up at 16-16 with a 51-yard make with eight seconds left in regulation. Szmyt has now gone 19-for-21 on field-goal tries, including 3-for-3 from 50-plus yards, over nine contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

4258620.headline: Szmyt made both of his field-goal attempts in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
4258620.story: Szmyt converted his 31-yard and 32-yard field-goal attempts in the second quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker accounted for all six of the Browns' points in the divisional loss. Szmyt is now 16-for-18 on field-goal attempts and 11-for-12 on PATs through eight regular-season games in 2026.

4258620.headline: Szmyt went 2-for-3 on field-goal tries while making all three of his extra-point attempts during Sunday's 27-24 win over Tennessee.
4258620.story: Szmyt converted exactly two field goals for the fifth straight week, while Sunday's performance marked his sixth in a row with multiple field-goal makes. The kicker made a 28-yarder as time expired in the first half before hitting the right upright on a 43-yard miss with 14:09 left in the fourth quarter. Szmyt got his redemption later, though, nailing a game-winning 32-yard try in the final seconds of the game. The 28-year-old has now gone 14-for-16 on field-goal tries while making 11 of 12 PATs over the first seven contests during the 2026 campaign.
